why: Gentle ground holds rain long enough to soak in; steep ground sheds it as runoff (Nijesh 2024; Joshi 2024).
Forest litter and roots let water in; built-up and bare ground seal or crust the surface (ESA WorldCover 2021).
How easily the mapped rock passes water through pores and fractures (GSI NGDR lithology; SOP ch. 3).
Fractures along faults and lineaments carry water down into the rock (Rathi 2021; ICIMOD 2018). Distance to the nearest GSI fault or DEM lineament.
